reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and I always forget pills at home when I travel. A sachet I can toss in my bag with the capsules already counted, plus a lab report I can check, makes me willing to try one box at the launch price.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule? I also want to know the bisglycinate dose really does something for me before I commit to a second box.
